newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian Socialists allege vote list fraud.
newsitem.headline: Albanian Socialists allege vote list fraud.

text.p: Albania's opposition Socialists have accused the ruling Democratic Party of rigging Tirana voting lists ahead of local elections on October 20, socialist daily Zeri i popullit said on Friday.

The newspaper reported that the Socialist Party had complained to the electoral commission, alleging that the voters' register in the capital included the names of 22,000 people who had died or left the country.
"If...the lists are not corrected we will start penal cases against those responsible for this electoral falsification," the newspaper quoted Tirana Socialist branch leader Musa Ulqini as saying.
No one at Socialist Party headquarters was immediately available for comment.

Albania's nationwide local elections come five months after a disputed general election. Most opposition parties withdrew from that poll, alleging widespread vote manipulation and intimidation -- charges upheld by some international observers.

All political parties have put forward heavyweight candidates for the post of Tirana mayor. Western governments have signalled that they consider the local elections a test of Albania's young democracy.
